_about: The screenshots of the site. Each one is <name>.png in tools/site/shots/ (not published) or in site/assets/img/ (published as it is) - English interface, dark theme unless the name says otherwise; the PNG files are kept as they are. A language's own screenshots lie in tools/site/shots/<lang>/<name>.png (zh, ja, ko); a picture without one shows the English copy. The build makes WebP copies in site/assets/img/gen/ and gen/<lang>/: 'cover' first paints rectangles [left, top, right, bottom] (source pixels) with the colour found just right of each one, or at [.., x, y] when a sixth and seventh number are given - used to keep a graphics card's model, a user folder or a test version out of the pictures; 'crop' then cuts [left, top, right, bottom] out of the source; 'width' caps the width of the published copy. 'langs': {'zh': {...}} gives a language's own 'cover', 'crop' or 'width' (the English values otherwise). 'look' sets how the figure sits on the page: 'window' (a whole window, as wide as the text) or 'panel' (a part of the window, at most 'show' CSS pixels wide). A picture that is missing is left out of the pages and named by the build.
